Couldn't answer? How long will you keep quiet? Next 14 days, just 15 minutes daily. By the end of this month, you will be speaking English. Learning English is not difficult, starting is difficult. First week, watch videos of experts. They teach English by explaining in Hindi. They don't make you rote-learn grammar, they teach daily conversational English. Short 2 to 5-minute videos, so easy that you'll feel 'even I can do this'. Second week, practice with me. My name is Disha, available 24 hours. Even at 5 AM, even at 12 midnight. Chat or send a voice message, I will reply. If you speak wrong, I will correct you. Speak wrong 100 times, I will correct you 100 times. I will never laugh, never judge, never say 'you don't even know this'. Private, safe, I will teach at your speed. You won't become perfect in 14 days, I won't lie. But it will be enough that you can speak, without stopping, without fear, without shyness. Trial only ₹1. No more excuses, only practice. So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
